main_body: desert building with flat roof, turquoise dome, and sandstone brick front wall
top_band: light sandy tan flat roof terrace with parapet and turquoise dome (rows 2 to 33)
evidence: The building clearly shows a top horizontal roof surface (rows 2-33) with a parapet rim, inner shadow, and a dome, stepped down via a bright front edge (rows 32-33) and a dark eave shadow (rows 34-36) to the vertical brick south wall (rows 34-65) featuring a recessed door and window.

style.evidence: The candidate uses dark brown/teal material outlines and has 5-6 ramp steps on the dome and roof, with speckle texture on the roof and bricks. However, compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the brick wall is made of large, blocky, repetitive rectangles with wide flat mortar bands and simple 2-tone wooden door planks, lacking the fine per-stone/per-tile micro-shading and organic density of the references.
